# USAgentLeads

> USAgentLeads is a verified real estate agent contact database covering all 50 US states. It provides 1,000,000+ agent contacts with name, email, phone, and state as instant CSV downloads.

USAgentLeads is a B2B data provider specializing in real estate agent contact information. The database is compiled from public sources including state licensing records, MLS listings, Zillow, Realtor.com, and major brokerage sites, then verified for accuracy. The dataset is refreshed on a regular cycle (current dataset: July 2026). It serves coaches, SaaS/PropTech companies, mortgage lenders, marketing agencies, brokerages, lead generation companies, home services businesses, insurance agencies, real estate photographers, and moving companies that need to reach licensed real estate professionals.

Key facts: 1,000,000+ contacts across all 50 states; fields are full name, email, phone, and state; 90%+ email deliverability; phone numbers on roughly 40% of records; delivered as CSV downloads; 30-day money-back guarantee; not affiliated with NAR or any MLS. Support: support@usagentleads.com.

## Products & Pricing

- [State Pack](https://www.usagentleads.com/states): $99 one-time per state. A single state's agent list as a CSV. Instant delivery, guest checkout, no account required.
- [Full Database](https://www.usagentleads.com/pricing): $399 one-time. All 50 states, 1,000,000+ contacts in one CSV. Beats stacking state packs at 5+ states.
- [Free Sample](https://www.usagentleads.com): Free 500-contact sample CSV to evaluate data quality. No account or credit card required.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.usagentleads.com): Product overview, free sample, and pricing.
- [Pricing](https://www.usagentleads.com/pricing): One-time State Pack and Full Database options.
- [Browse by State](https://www.usagentleads.com/states): Per-state agent counts and purchase links for all 50 states.
- [Agent Directory](https://www.usagentleads.com/directory): Free, searchable public directory of agents.
- [Free Tools](https://www.usagentleads.com/tools): Browser-based planning tools for businesses reaching real estate agents.
- [Agent Outreach Campaign Planner](https://www.usagentleads.com/tools/agent-outreach-campaign-planner): Free tool to model selected-state email availability, outreach workload, funnel assumptions, and campaign economics.
- [Cold Email Compliance Checker](https://www.usagentleads.com/tools/cold-email-compliance-checker): Browser-based review of common text-level CAN-SPAM flags in a draft; it is not a legal certification.
- [Real Estate Email Subject Line Tester](https://www.usagentleads.com/tools/real-estate-email-subject-line-tester): Compare two agent-outreach drafts for length, compact previews, clarity prompts, and unresolved personalization tokens; it does not predict open rates.
- [Email Domain Authentication Checker](https://www.usagentleads.com/tools/email-domain-authentication-checker): Inspect public SPF and DMARC DNS records for an outreach domain; it does not prove DKIM passing or inbox placement.
- [Brokerage Recruiting ROI Calculator](https://www.usagentleads.com/tools/brokerage-recruiting-roi-calculator): Model retained recruits, annual company dollar, recruiting cost, ROI, and payback from your own brokerage assumptions.
- [Agent Partnership Value Calculator](https://www.usagentleads.com/tools/agent-partnership-value-calculator): Model introductions, qualified opportunities, wins, and relationship-program contribution without calculating referral payments or fees.
- [API Documentation](https://www.usagentleads.com/docs): Endpoints, authentication, and response format.
- [Import Guides](https://www.usagentleads.com/guides): How to load the CSV into common email and CRM tools.
- [Blog](https://www.usagentleads.com/blog): Guides on realtor outreach, marketing, and CRMs.
- [Data Sources](https://www.usagentleads.com/data-sources): Where the records are compiled from.
- [FAQ](https://www.usagentleads.com/faq): Common questions on data, delivery, and refunds.
- [About](https://www.usagentleads.com/about): Company background.
- [Contact](https://www.usagentleads.com/contact): Support and sales contact.
